description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 4, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.
